V2_BLOCKS.daily_loops_to_the_first.notes: n = 20 542, start 4: the last then the first.

V2_BLOCKS.daily_the_next_day.notes: The next day, the next two.

V2_BLOCKS.dates_on_another_type_of_block.notes: A-Q2: dates on any block; a carousel keeps its families, in their order.

V2_BLOCKS.fixed_shows_the_first.notes: « fixed »: the first X of the reserve, every day.

V2_BLOCKS.hidden_before_its_start.notes: A-Q2: hidden before its start, with no new send.

V2_BLOCKS.paris_day_before_the_utc_day.notes: 00:30 in Paris (UTC+1) is already the 27th: the block changes at midnight in Paris, never at 01:00.

V2_BLOCKS.reserve_not_above_shown_is_sho.notes: EC (26/11): Y ≤ X, the Y families in their order, without turning.

V2_BLOCKS.summer_midnight_of_the_25th_oc.notes: Still summer time: midnight is 22:00 UTC.

V2_BLOCKS.summer_midnight_of_the_30th_ma.notes: Summer time since 01:00 UTC on the 29th: midnight in Paris is 22:00 UTC.

V2_BLOCKS.winter_last_second_of_the_25th.notes: Winter time since 01:00 UTC on the 25th: 23:59:59 in Paris.

V2_BLOCKS.winter_midnight_of_the_29th_ma.notes: Midnight in Paris, the day of the change.

V2_BUSINESS.price_of_a_v1_generation.notes: A SITE still serving a v1 catalogue prices it unchanged.

V2_BUSINESS.price_of_a_v2_generation.notes: F1 bought alone: its BASE window, from the v2 catalogue served.

V2_BUSINESS.promotion_from_ten_on_a_v2_g.notes: F1 from 10 units: its PROMOTION window, the same selection rule as in v1.

V2_CATALOGUE.v2_accepted.notes: V01, I09: a v2 catalogue is activated; the SITE holds the derivatives and the document, never the JPEG and TIFF originals.

V2_CATALOGUE.v2_ack_verified_by_v1.notes: The Factory checks the acknowledgement of a v2 publication with the frozen v1 verify_ack.

V2_CATALOGUE.v2_alias_meets_a_slug.notes: An old address of a family is never the address of another one.

V2_CATALOGUE.v2_category_image_unknown.notes: A category image is a declared media, like a family image.

V2_CATALOGUE.v2_coverage_proven.notes: The private manifest proves the v2 FULL catalogue, as in v1.

V2_CATALOGUE.v2_delivery_delay_blank.notes: 49e série: the lead time is one text or null, never a blank text (the SITE shows nothing for null).

V2_CATALOGUE.v2_delivery_delay_too_long.notes: The lead time is 120 characters at most, as typed in the Factory.

V2_CATALOGUE.v2_derivative_missing.notes: A derivative not received: MEDIA_MISSING, the previous catalogue stays served.

V2_CATALOGUE.v2_derivative_not_webp_png_.notes: A derivative is served: PNG, JPEG or WebP only. The original of a derived image may be any image type (TIFF here).

V2_CATALOGUE.v2_document_missing.notes: A PDF document is verified like an image.

V2_CATALOGUE.v2_missing_v2_key.notes: Every v2 field is present: an empty list or null, never absent.

V2_CATALOGUE.v2_own_range_absent_reads_f.notes: CA-5 (EC, 26/11): a family without own_range (a Factory from before CA-5, or taken back alone) is accepted; absent reads false. Only this key may be absent; every other key stays exact (v2_missing_v2_key).

V2_CATALOGUE.v2_own_range_not_yes_or_no.notes: CA-5: own_range is true or false, never a text (and never the supplier or the word that decides it).

V2_CATALOGUE.v2_own_range_null.notes: CA-5: own_range is true or false when it is given (absent reads false: v2_own_range_absent_reads_false); null is refused.

V2_CATALOGUE.v2_position_outside_its_cat.notes: A position is given only in a category of the family.

V2_CATALOGUE.v2_reference_amount_not_pos.notes: M01–M03: a struck price is the one the Calculator file gives (F4, a fixed-price lot, in v2_accepted), on any window, never 0.

V2_CATALOGUE.v2_replay.notes: Same v2 document again: the stored ACK, no second activation.

V2_CATALOGUE.v2_signed_under_the_v1_doma.notes: Signature domains are separated: a v1 signature never covers a v2 document.

V2_CATALOGUE.v2_to_a_v1_site.notes: V05: a SITE that reads only v1 refuses a v2 catalogue at the version stage; its served catalogue does not change.

V2_CATALOGUE.v2_unknown_key.notes: V04: an unknown key is refused with its rule; nothing is activated.

V2_COEXISTENCE.v1_read_by_a_v2_site.notes: V03: a SITE that reads v2 still activates a v1 catalogue (the frozen v1 receiver).

V2_COEXISTENCE.v2_after_a_v1_active.notes: The first v2 catalogue takes a v1 generation as its base (sequence, digest, explained withdrawals).

V2_CONTENT.block_date_not_utc.notes: A-Q2: the dates of a block are UTC instants, as for the announcement.

V2_CONTENT.block_ends_before_it_starts.notes: A-Q2: a block ends after it starts.

V2_CONTENT.content_accepted.notes: V07, V08: pages, settings, redirects and relations arrive by the signed channel, with no shared folder; the SITE acknowledges.

V2_CONTENT.content_ack_verified.notes: The Factory checks the SITE's acknowledgement before showing « reçue par le SITE ».

V2_CONTENT.content_html_in_a_setting.notes: E03: a setting is text; HTML in it is accepted as text and the SITE escapes it when it shows it.

V2_CONTENT.content_reference_missing.notes: V09: a content naming a family the SITE does not serve is refused whole; the previous content stays served.

V2_CONTENT.content_replay.notes: Same content again: the stored ACK.

V2_CONTENT.content_signed_under_the_cata.notes: A catalogue signature never covers a content.

V2_CONTENT.content_stale.notes: An older content never replaces the served one.

V2_CONTENT.content_unknown_key.notes: An unknown setting is refused with its rule.

V2_CONTENT.content_with_home_blocks.notes: CA-4 (A.3-d2, A-Q2): a « selection » block filled by the Factory, daily or fixed, and blocks with their own dates, of any type.

V2_CONTENT.novelty_count_zero.notes: N04: « Nouveautés » shows 1 to 200 families (24 to start) from the last 1 to 365 days (60 to start).

V2_CONTENT.redirect_chain.notes: S07: one hop only; a redirect target is never itself redirected.

V2_CONTENT.redirect_to_another_host.notes: 3.31: a redirect leads inside the SITE only (no « // »).

V2_CONTENT.redirect_with_a_scheme.notes: 3.31: no scheme in a redirect target.

V2_CONTENT.selection_empty_reserve.notes: A.3-d1: a block with an empty reserve is never sent (the Factory says « un bloc de l'accueil à compléter »); the SITE refuses one.

V2_CONTENT.selection_family_not_served.notes: V09 for a block: every family of the reserve is one the SITE serves.

V2_CONTENT.selection_rotation_unknown.notes: CA-4: « fixed » or « daily », nothing else.

V2_CONTENT.selection_shows_more_than_24.notes: CA-4: 24 is the technical bound common to the Factory and the SITE (« Pas sur la page » of the settings).

V2_CONTENT.selection_shows_none.notes: CA-4: a block shows 1 to 24 families.

V2_CONTENT.selection_source_unknown.notes: CA-4: the source is one of the five the Owner retained.

V2_PREVIEW.preview_accepted.notes: B14: a draft page, signed, naming the served catalogue, expiring in 20 minutes: the SITE keeps it and renders it.

V2_PREVIEW.preview_expired.notes: An expired preview is refused; so is one expiring more than 30 minutes after the SITE clock.

V2_PREVIEW.preview_reference_missing.notes: A preview naming a family the SITE does not serve is refused, as a content would be.

V2_PREVIEW.preview_too_long.notes: The SITE never keeps a preview more than 30 minutes.
